mentions.name: OxPower
mentions.description: A cloud hosting platform that exposes the cloud as a single Docker host: no VMs to manage, just containers, with easy controls to set the number of CPUs, RAM, and disk each container has access to. Written in Rust. Inspired by Joyent's discontinued public container offering.
mentions.problem: Cloud deployments typically require managing VMs; a prior service of this kind (Joyent's public offering) was shut down after acquisition.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building a cloud hosting company that exposes the cloud as a single docker host. No VMs to manage, just containers and easy controls to set the number of CPUs, RAM, disk that you want your containers to have access to.

evidence.value: I am building a cloud hosting company that exposes the cloud as a single docker host. No VMs to manage, just containers and easy controls to set the number of CPUs, RAM, disk that you want your containers to have access to.
